patch_description: Separates demand preparation, sparse path-factor generation, and local neighbor-profile factors into small stages. Path candidates are ranked using leg balance and transit pressure, with a third route retained only when it is close to the selection boundary. Local factors score pairs of outgoing or incoming neighbors by their estimated service profiles, giving the energy a signal about complementary routing capacity as well as direct demand. All factors share one additive accumulator so overlapping terms are handled consistently and the coupling count stays bounded.
